summary: Vovchok Academy Telegram Mini App tested end-to-end in mobile viewport 390x844 at https://vovchok-mini.preview.emergentagent.com/api/miniapp/. All requested flows PASSED: onboarding funnel across ru/uk/ar with RTL for Arabic; bottom nav (5 tabs, each with distinct <svg> in .nav-ico, active gets class 'on'); Learn (12 modules, m1 has 5 items l1-l4+p); lesson player (step counter 'ШАГ 1 / 2', prev on first page returns to lesson list, last page shows 'Завершить урок', toast 'Урок пройден ✓', auto-advances to next lesson, scenario-chart canvas + lesson-wolf-bubble render); Practice (13 items m1p..m12p2; m1p 'call' -> '✓ Верно' + wolf mood='correct'; m4p wrong 'call' -> '✕ Неверно' + 'Правильный ответ: Вниз' + practice-retry-button + wolf mood='warning'; practice-next-button enabled after answer); Profile (12 module-map cells, counters 'N / 50' and 'N / 13', progress bar, language switcher, profile-reset-button resets to 0 with toast); Community (3 cards with correct t.me/comfortrade hrefs, all target=_blank, community-rules present); risk-disclaimer rendered on home, profile, community; localized labels correct in all 3 languages (ru: Вверх/Вниз/Ждать · uk: Вгору/Вниз/Чекати · ar: صعود/هبوط/انتظار — no CALL/PUT/WAIT anywhere); Progress persistence works (localStorage va_progress with done.m1l1 -> after reload home-progress-text shows 'Пройдено 1 из 50 · 2%' and home-continue-button visible). window.VA_MISSING remains [] after visiting every screen in every language. Zero JS console errors. Bot sanity: LABELS loaded from trade-labels.js for ru/uk/ar including *_full keys, tx('uk','hello') renders localized text, app_url('ar') = '.../?lang=ar&v=v3'. tools/check-i18n.js exits 0 with output 'i18n OK — перевод полный на всех языках'. No deprecated Expo packages (this is a vanilla JS mini app, not React Native). No SafeAreaView issues. No red screens. No infinite loops — clicks are responsive.
critical_code_review_comments: player.js sets wolf mood via el.querySelector('.ava') scoped to the practice screen — correct pattern. Progress key 'va_progress' matches spec.

community screen renders VA.disclaimer(true) (short) — visible detail block scoped to #community; home/profile also include their own risk-disclaimer instances (multiple copies exist in DOM but only the current screen's is visible, which is expected).
seed_data_creation: For persistence check, injected localStorage: va_uid='demo', va_lang='ru', va_progress={done:{m1l1:<ts>}, practice:{}, last:{m:1,i:0}}. Cleared each run with ?reset=1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vanilla JS mini app served by FastAPI StaticFiles at /api/miniapp/. Use ?reset=1 to clear localStorage, then step through onboarding via testids onboarding-lang-{ru|uk|ar}, onboarding-start-button, onboarding-about-next, onboarding-have-account, onboarding-uid-input+onboarding-check-button (wait ~2.5s for auto scan), onboarding-enter-button. To bypass onboarding: set localStorage va_uid='demo' and navigate to #home. Lesson buttons testid pattern: lesson-{lessonId}-button (e.g. lesson-m1l1-button, lesson-m1p-button). Practice buttons: practice-{lessonId}-button. Wolf avatar element uses [data-testid='wolf-avatar'] with data-mood attribute — practice avatar's mood updates to 'correct'/'warning' after answering. Multiple risk-disclaimer nodes exist in the DOM (one per screen container); only the active-screen one is visible — scope checks with getBoundingClientRect. Bot: cd /app/miniapp && BOT_TOKEN=x python -c 'import bot; ...'. i18n lint: node /app/miniapp/tools/check-i18n.js.
rca_of_issue: No bugs to RCA. All previously-reported issues (dead/static UI, indistinct nav icons, unstyled community, missing guide on some screens) are resolved: motion.css powers entry animations; icons.js renders distinct SVG per tab; community cards styled and clickable; wolf-avatar + bubble present on lesson/practice/home/profile/community screens.
